method: Windows native UI smoke against the packaged executable

regressions.steps: Select 011 幕后浮现, then select 012 激战大魔神
regressions.observed: Both maps rendered with real tiles; the second selection changed immediately without traceback, freeze, or stale data

modules.observed: Ctrl+D opened the database; the battle-dialogue tab displayed real records and editable text controls
Other 1 displayed the level 1-99 table plus hit and distance tables
Other 2 displayed 24 items, prices and descriptions, shops F0-FE, and clerk-dialogue controls
Ctrl+W opened the character-library editor with the 16x16 glyph grid and real glyph data (啊 at C8/070010)
Ctrl+M opened decoded map-animation data; background rule $02 was visibly marked dynamic/incomplete and read-only
The text converter completed an in-memory round trip: 啊 -> C8 00 -> 啊
Ctrl+J opened all six event tabs with real map records; the action-event tab showed 256/256 actions and 2541/2751 bytes used
The attribute calculator opened and produced both-side hit, double-hit, expected-damage, and post-hit HP results
The save editor opened with slot/chapter selectors, four workflow buttons, and two 11-column tables
Ctrl+T opened the Other window with double-hit, damage, hit, item-effect, and initial-mecha controls populated from the ROM

Ctrl+F opened the native unit-export save dialog; Data -> Export Portrait remained disabled and Ctrl+L performed no action per D2; Extensions -> Export Portrait BMP (Enhanced) opened its folder chooser

limitations: This smoke test validates packaged UI entry points, rendering, read-only flows, and cancellation paths only.
It does not replace the per-module save/reopen, emulator, visual-quality, or reference-golden steps in the user acceptance checklists.
M12 remains a declared safe-subset implementation; passing this smoke test does not upgrade it to full implementation.
No user acceptance fields were filled by this run.
